ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; dominant high-intensity pixels (white) comprising approximately 70% of the visible surface, bounded by low-intensity pixels (black) at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dominant, contiguous white region occupies the central expanse of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips, forming a complex web-like pattern. A black vertical gradient is centered at the median notch and extends into the lower fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 75 degrees; the notch depth occupies roughly 20% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude jagged serrations with four primary distinct peaks. The left lobe trailing edge displays lower-frequency undulations with a smoother boundary profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow a clean convex trajectory. The trailing edges exhibit an irregular path with significant concave dips moving from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four distinct, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacle scars) localized within the low-intensity black region of the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting diagonally and vertically through the high-intensity white fields of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma evidenced by irregular tissue loss and jagged serrations on the right lobe trailing edge; multiple white circular scarring rosettes on the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly intricate, filigree-style black pigmentation localized to the outer lobes, creating a sharp boundary against the solid white interior field.
